name: indahl-silent-failure-guard
description: After any action that claims it worked (a push, a deploy, a job, a migration), read the effect back from where it should have landed instead of trusting the exit code. Returns VERIFIED, FAILED, NOTHING_RETURNED or CANNOT_TELL per action. Also scans scripts for patterns that hide failures.

defaultPrompt: Verify what this push actually did.
